metadata.title: Tungrymbai | Fermented Soybeans | Khasi Recipe
metadata.description:
Tungrymbai or fermented soybean paste is a much loved dish in the Northeastern India. States such as Manipur, Nagaland, Mizoram and Arunachal pradesh have their own versions of this.

Tungrymbai is an authentic Khasi ingredient and there are many different ways to prepare the fermented soybean paste, in this video I show you how Tungrymbai is normally prepared in our home. A simple, quick and easy method.
